annotations.title: How do I authenticate with this MCP server?

description: The AUTH LADDER: classify any MCP server URL — 'open' (no credential), 'key' (paste a token into the vault once), 'tier1' (one-click account-wide Connect for a known provider), or 'oauth_spec' (the MCP auth spec — connect directly, approve in a browser). Returns the one right next step. Works without login.
